messages:
maggie: Staging deploy for hotfix/kv-cache-regen PR #1298 is ready for expedited push. Affects embeddings ingestion in EU1. Need approvals within next 20m. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m hold at first stage. Links: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/1298, runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kv-cache-hotfix, changelog snippet attached.

deploybot: DeployBot: created release hotfix-kv-1298 -> staging (image rkv-1298). Canary strategy: gradual percent. Trigger with `/deploy start hotfix-kv-1298 --canary`.

sahil: Staging smoke run results? any mem/latency regressions?

maggie: Staging smoke passed. p95 latency +12ms, no mem spikes. Full smoke logs: https://logs/redwood/staging/1298.

jordan: ops-oncall, can you own the cutover window?

ops-oncall: I can take oncall until 13:00 UTC. Rollback criteria please. I want a 10m hold at 10% before moving on.

maggie: Rollback criteria in runbook (summarized): 1) 5xx rate > 0.3% sustained for 5m, 2) p95 latency increase > 250ms sustained 5m, 3) tokenization error rate > 0.1% for 10m. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback hotfix-kv-1298`.

kim: +1 from runtime tests. :thumbsup:

paul: Security looked at changes (no new surface area). +1. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: Requesting canary to remain at 10% for 10m, then we evaluate metrics and decide.

maggie: Ack. Starting canary now. I'll post quick summaries.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary rollout for hotfix-kv-1298 started at 12:05 UTC — 10% traffic to new image.

sahil: I'll tighten monitoring windows and enable per-region error alarms. Watching EU1 ingest.

maggie: Quick note — metrics to watch: embeddings failure rate, tokenization errors, and tail latency for seq_len>1024.

12:09 deploybot: Canary at 10% complete checks: error rate 0.02%, p95 latency change +15ms — PASS.

jordan: Seeing normal traffic patterns, nothing alarming.

maggie: Collecting approvals for prod push. Please react with :shipit: to approve rollout to prod after canary. We need at least two ops/product approvals.

kim: :shipit:

paul: :shipit: — security good.

ops-oncall: Holding until 12:15 UTC to review 10m window.

12:14 maggie: Canary hold finished, metrics still green. Requesting releasebot to queue prod.

releasebot: ReleaseBot: production deploy queued for hotfix-kv-1298. Scheduled to start 12:25 UTC. Requires two operator acknowledgements; those are present.

maggie: Rolling to 50% now as canary progression.

deploybot: DeployBot: rollout progressed to 50% at 12:26 UTC — running automated checks.

sahil: No spike observed. Logs look clean.

maggie: Proceeding to 100% in 5m unless ops raise flag.

deploybot: DeployBot: rollout to 100% complete at 12:31 UTC. All healthchecks OK.

ops-oncall: Monitoring — metrics green for 10m after full rollout. No rollback needed.

maggie: Thanks everyone. I'll merge release notes and update the incident page with the rollout trace. Release notes: https://changelogs/redwood/hotfix-kv-1298. Closing thread after final checks.

paul: Noted. Good job shipping quickly and safely. :thumbsup:
